questions.feedback: That trap answer is the one to unlearn: 25% of 60 is just 25. Reteach point: Percent means per hundred, and the whole here is 60: 25% of 60 is a quarter of 60, which is 15.

questions.answer: 25% is one quarter, and 60 / 4 = 15, so 25% of 60 = 15.
questions.feedback: Scene s3 locks the method: turn 25% into one quarter first, then divide the whole into quarters to reach 15.
questions.prompt: Work out 25% of 60, showing the quarter step.

questions.feedback: Scene s1 and s3 fix the fraction: 25% is 25 out of 100, and 25/100 simplifies to 1/4 - one quarter of the whole.
questions.prompt: 25% as a fraction in its simplest form is...

questions.answer: The 25 in 25% counts out of one hundred, not out of 60: the answer is a share of 60, and one quarter of 60 is 15.
questions.feedback: Scene s2 names the mix-up: the 25 belongs to the hundred-grid, while the whole in this question is 60 - two different wholes.
